summary: A wooden tower at McCall, dated to 1942 and abandoned in 1950, now listed as gone. No source describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source gives a removal date or describes what remains.

evidence.supports: placed at USFS compound in McCall
lookouts in Valley County from the 1920s, after 1910 fires
evidence.quote: Lookouts first started dotting the landscape of Valley County in the 1920s, spurred by a destructive series of forest fires in 1910.

notes_for_editor: Record point 44.90944, -116.10722 matches the Association list and sits in McCall town; firelookout.com places the tower at the USFS compound in McCall, so the point may be the compound rather than a tower site. Gone status comes only from the Association list and has no date. No staffing, fires or access in any source; left out. The 1920s and 1910 context is county-level, from a tourism page, not McCall-specific.
